lines.text: It was raining outside, but Mai's little room was warm and cozy.
lines.say: It was raining outside, but Mai's little room was warm, and cozy.

lines.text: She made a cup of Vietnamese coffee and sipped it slowly.
The sound of the rain was so soothing.
lines.say: The sound of the rain... was so soothing.

lines.text: Soon, she felt drowsy, and she fell asleep.
lines.say: Soon, she felt drowsy... and she fell asleep.
